item.title: Anti-skid Chains made Mandatory on Tangmarg–Gulmarg road
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 16: The Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) Gulmarg on Friday issued an advisory mandating the compulsory use of anti-skid chains for all vehicles plying on the Tangmarg–Gulmarg road in view of the forecast of snowfall and icy conditions in the area. According to the order, snowfall is expected in the Tangmarg–Gulmarg sector, which may render the road slippery and unsafe for vehicular traffic. item.title: Fresh Snowfall reported in higher reaches of Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 16: Fresh snowfall was reported across several higher reaches of Kashmir on Friday late afternoon, as winter conditions intensified in the region, bringing relief to alpine areas and adding to the seasonal snow cover. According to details, Gurez Plains received around two inches of fresh snowfall, while Drass recorded about one inch. item.title: R-Day: LG to take salute, CM to attend as chief Guest
item.description: Jammu: Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha will preside over and take the salute at the main Republic Day function to be held at Maulana Azad Stadium, Jammu, on January 26, as Jammu and Kashmir steps up preparations for the national celebrations amid heightened security across the Union Territory. item.title: SOG detains Sidhra resident over suspected cross-border contact
item.description: SUMIT SHARMA Jammu: In a significant security-related development, a team of the Special Operations Group (SOG), Jammu, on Thursday morning detained a resident of Sidhra for questioning in connection with suspected communication links across the border. item.title: Ladakh Freezes at –9.9°C as Sub-Zero Cold grips Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 17: Ladakh continued to reel under extreme cold conditions, emerging as the coldest region, while the Kashmir Valley recorded widespread sub-zero temperatures and the Jammu region experienced comparatively milder winter conditions. According to data compiled by Kashmir Weather, Drass recorded the lowest minimum temperature at minus 9.9 degrees Celsius. item.title: Shab-e-Meraj celebrated across Kashmir valley
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 17: Shab-e-Meraj was observed across the Kashmir Valley on Friday night, with night-long prayers held in mosques and shrines despite the ongoing Chillai–Kalan, the 40-day period of the harshest winter in the region. Devotees gathered at various places of worship to offer special prayers seeking peace, prosperity, and forgiveness. item.title: Jammu–Srinagar Highway reopens for Two-Way Traffic amid heavy rush
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 17: The Jammu-Srinagar National Highway is open for two-way traffic on Saturday however, heavy congestion was reported at several places along the vital arterial road, causing inconvenience to commuters. Traffic officials said that despite the highway being operational for both sides, traffic jams were witnessed at multiple stretches due to high vehicle volume and frequent overtaking by motorists.
